Name: Beth-millo
Description: The house of Millo at Shechem, whose men with all the men of Shechem made Abimelech king, and where King Joash was later slain by his servants.
BiblicalSignificance: Beth-millo is Shechem's stronghold turned twice to blood: a king made there, and a king murdered there generations later.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, Son of Gideon; Joash, King of Judah
